name: Rolls-Royce Holdings plc
why_them: Excluded under the defence sector rule. Rolls-Royce has a material Defence division, which reported 2025 underlying revenue of £4,772m out of group underlying revenue of £20,059m, about 24% (https://www.rolls-royce.com/~/media/Files/R/Rolls-Royce/documents/annual-report/2026/2025-annual-report.pdf). Defence covers combat, submarines, naval and transport. The company would otherwise be a large corporate with capacity. I did not review its STEM or education programmes or grant routes, because the exclusion applies first.
to_verify: Confirm the exclusion with the team if the defence rule should not apply to a division of this size (about 24% of group revenue)
